items.description: plym is a zero-maintenance hosted blogging platform positioned as a WordPress alternative; it renders posts to static files, scores 100/100 PageSpeed, attaches to your site (e.g. yoursite.com/blog), and serves an AI-friendly version of every page for SEO and GEO (ranking in Google, citation in ChatGPT)
Pricing: plym Cloud is fully managed, from $49/month, four plans, 7-day free trial with no credit card required; the base plan includes five members and unlimited posts at a flat price
